enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping at home with the light off and the fan on, recovering before a full university day
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Move legs. Turn to back. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and washing up for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast, boiling the kettle for tea and packing a packed lunch and snacks
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, and vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Slice vegetables. Heat pan on induction cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Cook omelette. Toast bread in toaster. Flip omelette. Turn off induction cooker. Place omelette on plate. Put bread on plate. Eat breakfast with fork. Boil kettle. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Steep tea. Remove tea bag. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container. Prepare packed lunch with leftovers. Add snacks to bag. Close refrigerator. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from Clayton towards the Monash University campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Arrive at station. Stand up. Exit train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Get off bus. Walk to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a Master of Social Work coursework lecture and taking detailed written notes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Find seat. Sit down. Take out notebook. Take out pen. Open notebook. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Turn page. Look at slides. Write more notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to answer. Write summary. Close notebook. Put pen down.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending a small-group social work tutorial and contributing to the group discussion
enriched_activities.desc: Enter tutorial room. Sit in circle. Greet group. Open notebook. Listen to tutor. Contribute to discussion. Say "I think that's a good point." Listen to peer. Nod head. Take notes. Raise hand. Speak again. Say "I agree with the group." Write down conclusion. Close notebook.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed flexitarian lunch on campus while reading assigned articles in the library
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to library. Find empty table. Sit down. Open backpack. Take out lunch container. Open container. Take out fork. Eat lunch. Chew food. Drink water. Close container. Put fork back. Take out article. Read article. Highlight text. Write notes. Check phone. Reply to message.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending afternoon Master of Social Work seminars and case-study workshops
enriched_activities.desc: Enter seminar room. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open notebook. Listen to speaker. Type notes. Participate in case-study discussion. Raise hand. Speak. Listen to feedback. Write down key points. Take a short break. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Resume discussion. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library, reviewing readings, checking written messages and noting placement tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at library desk. Open textbook. Read chapter. Highlight important sections. Write summary notes. Open phone. Check messages. Reply to text. Open calendar. Note placement tasks. Close phone. Continue reading. Close textbook. Pack bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home by bus and train from the Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait on platform. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Arrive at station. Stand up. Exit train. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking the bag, changing into home clothes and checking reminders and the calendar on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Put bag on floor. Open bag. Take out books. Place books on desk. Take out lunch container. Place on desk. Take out phone. Check reminders. Open wardrobe. Take out home clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off shoes. Take off jacket. Take off pants. Put on home clothes. Pick up phone. Check calendar.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a vegetarian dinner and drinking tea
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add spices. Cook dinner. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing the dishes, wiping the shared bench and tidying the kitchen after dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Carry plate to sink. Scrape food into bin. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Apply soap. Wash plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Pick up cup. Wash cup. Rinse cup. Place cup in drying rack. Pick up sponge. Wipe bench. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading coursework material at the desk with the desk lamp on and typing study notes on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open textbook. Read chapter. Open computer. Turn on computer. Open document. Type notes. Read more. Highlight text. Type more notes. Save document. Close textbook. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Writing and sending text-only messages to confirm the house meeting agenda and next week's shift plans
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select group chat. Type message: "Can we confirm the house meeting agenda?" Send message. Wait for reply. Read reply. Type message: "I'm available next week for shifts." Send message. Open calendar. Check shift schedule. Close app. Lock phone. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle for tea, preparing overnight oats and tomorrow's lunch, and checking the weekly budget against cash spent
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open refrigerator. Take out oats. Take out milk. Take out yogurt. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out jar. Pour oats into jar. Pour milk into jar. Add yogurt. Stir mixture. Close jar. Place jar in refrigerator. Open phone. Open budget app. Check spending. Compare with cash. Close app.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing a load of laundry and putting clothes through the dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Open washing machine door. Load dirty clothes. Add detergent. Close door. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer door. Transfer clothes from washer to dryer. Close dryer door. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer door. Take out clothes. Fold clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and completing night-time dental care
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth again. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly in bed and setting phone reminders and an alarm for tomorrow's rostered shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Get into bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:00. Open reminder app. Set reminder for shift. Lock phone. Put phone on nightstand. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping at home with the light off and the fan running for quiet rest
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side. Pull blanket down. Turn to right side. Remain asleep.
